dimensions.evidenceA: The return command comes “in the third year.”
dimensions.evidenceB: The sky is described as shut for three years and six months.
dimensions.label: Time statement

dimensions.evidenceA: Elijah is sent to Ahab before rain returns.
dimensions.evidenceB: Jesus recalls Elijah while speaking in Nazareth.
dimensions.label: Narrative setting

dimensions.evidenceA: Kings locates the return command within the drought narrative.
dimensions.evidenceB: James also states three years and six months while describing Elijah’s prayer.
dimensions.label: Apostolic duration

evidence.observation: After many days, in the third year, the LORD tells Elijah to show himself to Ahab and says he will send rain.
The sky was shut up three years and six months while a great famine came over all the land.

record.tension: The Kings return notice and Jesus’ recollection state the drought’s time differently.
record.title: How long is the drought described?
